intro: Chat with {agent}. Enter sends, Esc stops the agent's answer, /clear starts a new chat, /help shows the keys, Ctrl+C leaves.
images: Images cannot be sent from the terminal. Send them in Telegram or the console.
help.send: Enter sends your message; a pasted text stays one message.
help.stop: Esc, or /stop, stops the agent's answer. Anything you already confirmed still goes through.
help.clear: /clear starts a new chat. The agent forgets this conversation; its notes and files stay.
help.card: Ctrl+Y confirms the card shown at the bottom, Ctrl+N cancels it. A card waits 60 seconds.
help.question: While your line is empty, a number key picks an answer to the agent's question; a written message answers it too.
help.exit: Ctrl+C, or Ctrl+D on an empty line, leaves the chat.
reconnecting: The link to binference dropped. Reconnecting…
lost: binference stopped answering, so the chat closed. Run `binference status`, then `binference chat` again.
historyFailed: The chat so far could not load. {reason} Your messages still reach the agent.
otherError: Something went wrong. Run `binference logs` to see why.
cleared: A new chat has started. The agent forgets this conversation; its notes and files stay.
card.keys: {seconds, plural, one {# second left} other {# seconds left}} · Ctrl+Y Confirm · Ctrl+N Cancel
card.more: {count, plural, one {# more card waits} other {# more cards wait}} after this one
card.confirmed: Confirmed. {paper, select, yes {It fills on paper.} other {binference is sending it on chain.}}
card.unfrozen: Unfrozen. {scope, select, install {Every agent trades again within its limits, and new agents start unfrozen.} other {The agent trades again within its limits.}}
card.orderConfirmed: Confirmed. {outcome, select, started {The auto order is active.} expired {The auto order did not start: it expired before the confirmation.} unread {The auto order's state could not be read now.} other {The auto order did not start: it was cancelled first.}}
card.requoted: The price moved, so binference opened a new card version. Check it, then confirm again.
card.closed: {state, select, expired {The card expired. Nothing was sent.} denied {The card was cancelled elsewhere. Nothing was sent.} cancelled {The card was cancelled elsewhere. Nothing was sent.} other {The card was confirmed elsewhere.}}
question.keys: Press 1 to {last} to answer, or write your own answer.
